lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Landon Brennan is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: 🕯️ Landon Brennan is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Landon kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Landon's gone." Hassan looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Landon." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Imani blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Ritual & Meaning (Level 1). Marking the dead matters. Even without religion, ritual holds grief.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Landon Brennan, 41 days. The mantle passes to Imani Jung.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Imani Jung, 26 — a tattoo artist. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Green Thumb, Literally.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Landon — and Landon is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Anna, David, Demiana and 5 more speak for Imani — "Landon trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Imani before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

d51: 📖 LEARNED: Improvised Weapons (Level 1). Everything is a weapon if you're desperate. A rock, a stick, a handful of dirt in the eyes.
